arxiv-2101-09294.title: Censorship of Online Encyclopedias: Implications for NLP Models Conference: Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency; March 3–10, 2021; Virtual Event, Canada Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT ’21), March 3–10, 2021, Virtual Event, Canada DOI: 10.1145/344
arxiv-2101-09294.creator: Eddie Yang, Margaret E. Roberts
arxiv-2101-09294.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Eddie Yang, Margaret E. Roberts. While artificial intelligence provides the backbone for many tools people use around the world, recent work has brought to attention that the algorithms powering AI are not free of politics, stereotypes, and bias. While most work in this area has focused on the ways in which AI can exacerbate existing inequalities and discrimination, very little work has studied how governments actively shape training data.

arxiv-2110-13707.title: Quantum cryptographic resource distillation and entanglement
arxiv-2110-13707.creator: Minjin Choi, Soojoon Lee
arxiv-2110-13707.description: Abstract We look into multipartite quantum states on which quantum cryptographic protocols including quantum key distribution and quantum secret sharing can be perfectly performed, and define the quantum cryptographic resource distillable rate as the asymptotic rate at which such multipartite state can be distilled from a given multipartite state.

arxiv-2205-15667.title: ViT-BEVSeg: A Hierarchical Transformer Network for Monocular Birds-Eye-View Segmentation
arxiv-2205-15667.creator: Pramit Dutta, Ganesh Sistu, Senthil Yogamani, Edgar Galván, John McDonald
arxiv-2205-15667.description: Abstract Generating a detailed near-field perceptual model of the environment is an important and challenging problem in both self-driving vehicles and autonomous mobile robotics. A Bird’s Eye View (BEV) map, providing a panoptic representation, is a commonly used approach that provides a simplified 2D representation of the vehicle’s surroundings with accurate semantic level segmentation for many downstream tasks.

arxiv-2207-08803.title: Adversarial Pixel Restoration as a Pretext Task for Transferable Perturbations
arxiv-2207-08803.creator: Hashmat Shadab Malik, Shahina K Kunhimon, Muzammal Naseer, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan
arxiv-2207-08803.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Hashmat Shadab Malik, Shahina K Kunhimon, Muzammal Naseer, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan. Transferable adversarial attacks optimize adversaries from a pretrained surrogate model and known label space to fool the unknown black-box models. Therefore, these attacks are restricted by the availability of an effective surrogate model. In this work, we relax this assumption and propose Adversarial Pixel Restoration as a self-supervised alternative to train an effective surrogate model from scratch under the condition of no labels and few data samples.

arxiv-2210-11328.title: Play It Back: Iterative Attention for Audio Recognition
arxiv-2210-11328.creator: Alexandros Stergiou, Dima Damen
arxiv-2210-11328.description: Abstract A key function of auditory cognition is the association of characteristic sounds with their corresponding semantics over time. Humans attempting to discriminate between fine-grained audio categories, often replay the same discriminative sounds to increase their prediction confidence. We propose an end-to-end attention-based architecture that through selective repetition attends over the most discriminative sounds across the audio sequence.

arxiv-2405-12224.title: MASTER THESIS
arxiv-2405-12224.description: Abstract Coronary artery disease (CAD) is one of the most common causes of death in the European Union and the USA. The crucial biomarker in its diagnosis is called Fractional Flow Reserve (FFR) and its in-vivo measurement is obtained via an invasive diagnostic technique in the form of coronagraphy.

arxiv-2407-17290.title: Searching for new heavy fermions with deep learning
arxiv-2407-17290.creator: S.V. Dordevic
arxiv-2407-17290.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by S.V. Dordevic. Deep learning models were developed and implemented to aid the search for new heavy fermion compounds. For the purpose of these calculations a database of more than 200 heavy fermions was compiled from the literature. The deep learning networks trained on the database were then used for regression calculations, and predictions were made about the coherence temperature, Sommerfeld coefficient and carrier effective mass of potential new heavy fermions.

arxiv-2408-13679.title: Segment Any Mesh
arxiv-2408-13679.creator: George Tang, William Zhao, Logan Ford, David Benhaim, Paul Zhang
arxiv-2408-13679.description: Abstract We propose Segment Any Mesh, a novel zero-shot mesh part segmentation method that overcomes the limitations of shape analysis-based, learning-based, and contemporary approaches. Our approach operates in two phases: multimodal rendering and 2D-to-3D lifting. In the first phase, multiview renders of the mesh are individually processed through Segment Anything to generate 2D masks.

arxiv-2505-13846.title: Extension of Dynamic Network Biomarker using the propensity score method: Simulation of causal effects on variance and correlation coefficient
arxiv-2505-13846.creator: Satoru Shinoda
arxiv-2505-13846.description: Abstract In clinical biomarker studies, the Dynamic Network Biomarker (DNB) is sometimes used. DNB is a composite variable derived from the variance and the Pearson correlation coefficient of biological signals. When applying DNB to clinical data, it is important to account for confounding bias. However, little attention has been paid to statistical causal inference methods for variance and correlation coefficients.

arxiv-2511-14497.title: Solving Navier-Stokes Equations Using Data-free Physics-Informed Neural Networks With Hard Boundary Conditions
arxiv-2511-14497.creator: Ritik Pal, Soubhik Mukherjee, Urmi Dutta, Arghya Choudhury
arxiv-2511-14497.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ritik Pal, Soubhik Mukherjee, Urmi Dutta, Arghya Choudhury. In recent years, Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have emerged as a powerful and robust framework for solving nonlinear differential equations across a wide range of scientific and engineering disciplines, including biology, geophysics, astrophysics and fluid dynamics. In the PINN framework, the governing partial differential equations, along with initial and boundary conditions, are encoded directly into the loss function, enabling the network to learn solutions that are consistent with the underlying physics.

openalex-w2982538063.creator: Manuel Ramos‐Casals, Pilar Brito‐Zerón, Stefano Bombardieri, Hendrika Bootsma, Salvatore De Vita, Thomas Dörner, Benjamin A. Fisher, Jacques‐Eric Gottenberg, Gabriela Hernández‐Molina, Agnes Kocher, Belchin Kostov, Aike A. Kruize

pmc-10640897.title: Endocarditis Without Risk Factors: Clinical Awareness Is Key
pmc-10640897.creator: Ines Pedrosa, Ana L Costa, Ana Reis e Melo, Margarida Tavares
pmc-10640897.description: Infective endocarditis (IE) is a relatively common disease that can manifest as a spectrum of clinical findings. Clinical awareness is key for the diagnosis.We present a case of a 14-year-old adolescent with fever, coughing, skin lesions, lip drooping, and quadrantanopia. Lumbar puncture was unremarkable and a head CT scan showed ischemic lesions. Blood cultures were positive for Staphylococcus aureus.

pmc-11392658.title: Carnosine and Retinol Synergistically Inhibit UVB-Induced PGE2 Synthesis in Human Keratinocytes through the Up-Regulation of Hyaluronan Synthase 2
pmc-11392658.creator: In Guk Park, Sun Hee Jin, Seungchan An, Min Won Ki, Won Seok Park, Hyoung-June Kim, Yongjoo Na, Minsoo Noh
pmc-11392658.description: Skin aging results from complex interactions of intrinsic and extrinsic factors, leading to structural and biochemical changes such as wrinkles and dryness. Ultraviolet (UV) irradiation leads to the degradation of hyaluronic acid (HA) in the skin, and the fragmented HA contributes to inflammation.

pmc-11641172.title: Plateau Pika Disturbance Changes Soil Bacterial Functions and Exoenzyme Abundance to Modulate the C Cycle Pathway in Alpine Grasslands
pmc-11641172.creator: Jing Li, Qing Wang, Baolong Zhu, Min Yang, Grzegorz Wegrzyn
pmc-11641172.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Plateau pika (Ochotona curzoniae) is crucial to soil organic carbon (SOC) storage in the Qinghai–Tibetan plateau (QTP), but its role in bacterial SOC metabolisms across different degraded alpine grasslands remains unclear. In this study, we investigated the soil physicochemical properties and the composition and function of the bacterial communities in control and pika-disturbed grasslands experiencing different degradation levels (undegraded, UDM; lightly, LDM; moderately, MDM and severely, SDM).

pmc-11726392.title: Prevalence and Postpartum Screening Practice for Type 2 Diabetes Following Gestational Diabetes (GDM) in a Tertiary Care Center in Western Saudi Arabia: A Three-Year Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-11726392.creator: Daniyah Alfitni, Maysaa Ageel, Ebtesam Alsulami, Abdullah Alzahrani
pmc-11726392.description: ObjectivesThis study analyzed the practices and findings on postpartum type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) screening among pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM).MethodsA retrospective cohort study was conducted at a tertiary care center in Western Saudi Arabia, between January 1, 2016, and December 31, 2018.

pmc-12492528.title: Expression profiling and functional characterization of LoNCED gene in the pollen abortion of Lilium spp.
pmc-12492528.creator: Haiyan Zhou, Xiang Li, Lan Ma, Qing Duan, Wenwen Du, Guangfen Cui, Xuewei Wu, Wenjie Jia, Hao Zhang
pmc-12492528.description: BackgroundLilium spp. are widely cultivated for their ornamental value, but excessive pollen production poses significant commercial challenges. Male sterility, especially in pollenless cultivars, offers a promising breeding strategy to improve market appeal. This study demonstrates that abscisic acid (ABA) biosynthesis, mediated by 9-cis-epoxycarotenoid dioxygenase (NCED)‌—a rate-limiting enzyme in ABA production—constitutes the pivotal mechanism underlying complete male sterility in Lilium.

pmc-12735030.title: Glial Ion Channels in Myelin Pathophysiology: Insights from Leukodystrophies
pmc-12735030.creator: Marcello Belfiore, Sergio Visentin, Elena Ambrosini, Carlo Musio, Marzia Martina
pmc-12735030.description: Leukodystrophies (LDs) constitute a heterogeneous group of genetic diseases in which mutations in glial cell genes lead to alterations in myelin formation and/or maintenance, ultimately causing white matter dysfunction. Increasing evidence on the genetic basis of LDs has revealed that proteins expressed not only by myelin-forming oligodendrocytes, but also by other glial cell types, play essential roles in myelination.

pmc-12746102.title: 3′UTR-derived small RNA couples acid resistance to metabolic reprogramming of Salmonella within macrophages
pmc-12746102.creator: Takeshi Kanda, Fang Liu, Hoda Kooshapour, Sarah Reichardt, Maolin Wang, Philippe Icyishaka, Nozomu Obana, Alexander J Westermann, Yanjie Chao, Masatoshi Miyakoshi
pmc-12746102.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Acid resistance is crucial for enterobacteria to withstand host acidic environments during infection, including the gastrointestinal tract and macrophage phagosomes. A key acid resistance mechanism of the facultative intracellular pathogen Salmonella is the expression of the arginine decarboxylase AdiA. While AdiA confers acid resistance via an H+-consuming reaction, we discover that the 3′-untranslated region (UTR) of adiA mRNA is processed by RNase E into a regulatory small RNA, AdiZ.

pmc-13063741.title: Effect of resin infiltration and remineralization on color restorability and stability of artificial demineralized enamel lesions
pmc-13063741.creator: Hebatallah Ali Yehia Saeed, Rana Abdel-Rehim Fouad Sedky, Eman Nasser Ahmed Diab
pmc-13063741.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to evaluate the effect of resin infiltration, remineralization and their combination on the color restorability of artificially acid demineralized enamel lesions in addition to the color stability of the aforementioned treatments after acid challenge and immersion in common staining beverages.MethodsA hundred and five specimens were obtained from the buccal and lingual surfaces of permanent posterior teeth.

pmc-13240991.title: Cohort Study: Risk of Gallstones and Biliary Complications With Glucagon‐Like Peptide‐1 Receptor Agonists in Type 2 Diabetes
pmc-13240991.creator: Mohamed H Eldesouki, Omar Alkasabrah, Mohammed Kloub, Hazem Abosheaishaa, Khaled Elfert, Arpit Sharma, Sherif Andrawes, Nikki Duong
pmc-13240991.description: BackgroundGlucagon‐like peptide‐1 receptor agonists (GLP‐1 RAs) are widely prescribed for type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) because of their benefits in glycemic control, weight reduction, and cardiovascular outcomes. This study evaluated the risk of gallbladder disease among diabetic patients treated with GLP‐1 RAs.MethodsA retrospective cohort analysis was performed using the TriNetX research network.

pmc-13300246.title: Family-Based Study Reveals PDE11A/PDE11A-AS1 Variants in Testicular Germ Cell Tumor Predisposition
pmc-13300246.creator: Luiza Côrtes, Ana Beatriz Rodrigues, Sara Martoreli Silveira, Julieta M. Ramírez-Mejía, Carine Spenassatto Dreyer, Mads M. Aagaard, Geysson Javier Fernandez, Ademar Lopes, José Carlos S. Trindade Filho, Silvia Regina Rogatto
pmc-13300246.description: Testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) is a common tumor type in young men. Family history of TGCT and its presence in twins support the involvement of inherited genetic factors. Germline exome sequencing was performed on monozygotic twins with TGCT and their parents. The twins presented compound heterozygous variants in PDE11A (rs776984134 and rs17400325) inherited from each parent.

pmc-13424326.title: Functional characterization of fungal endophytes with antagonistic and plant growth-promoting activities in maize
pmc-13424326.creator: Purusottam Majhi, Jharana Pradhan, Umakant Pradhan, Sandeep Kaushik, A K Shukla
pmc-13424326.description: Fungal endophytes play a crucial role in plant-microbe interactions by asymptomatically colonizing host tissues, enhancing plant growth, and providing defense. In the present study, three distinct endophytic fungi, namely Fusarium oxysporum CJR-1 (GenBank Accession No. PZ477045), Penicillium sp. CJR-2 (GenBank Accession No. PZ477429) and Aspergillus cf. terreus CJR-4 (GenBank Accession No. PZ477430) were isolated from Crotalaria juncea L.

pmc-13455128.title: Development of an evaluation indicator system for wound care quality based on the structure-process-outcome model: a mixed-methods study
pmc-13455128.creator: Yinfeng Hu, Caifei Li, Liqiong Zhou, Yanxia Chen
pmc-13455128.description: BackgroundAs population aging accelerates and the burden of chronic diseases increases, the incidence of chronic wounds such as diabetic foot ulcers and pressure injuries continues to rise. This trend not only worsens patient outcomes and quality of life but also strains the healthcare system.

pmc-13559637.title: The risk factors and patterns for distant metastasis in early-stage cervical adenocarcinoma patients receiving radical surgery and adjuvant radiotherapy: the ATTRACT study
pmc-13559637.creator: Jia-Wei Zhu, Xi-Lin Yang, Yun-Can Zhou, Yan You, Peng Peng, Hong-Nan Zhen, Xi Wang, Xin Lian, Jun-Fang Yan, Fu-Quan Zhang
pmc-13559637.description: BackgroundCervical adenocarcinoma (ADC) accounts for 15–25% of cervical cancer cases and carries a higher risk of distant metastasis (DM) and a poorer prognosis than squamous cell carcinoma (SCC). However, the DM patterns and risk factors in ADC patients receiving radical surgery and postoperative radiotherapy (PORT) remain insufficiently characterized.

pmc-13580073.title: Fermentation-driven valorization of cereal by-products: Mechanisms, functional applications, and emerging AI-assisted approaches
pmc-13580073.creator: Yibo Chen, Chuang Liu, Tianyin Chen, Tianxiang Xue, Mengwei Chang, Yufeng He, Kunlun Liu, Guangsu Zhu
pmc-13580073.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Cereal processing generates abundant by-products, which remain underutilized despite being rich in bioactive compounds. Recent studies highlight the crucial role of fermentation in releasing bound compounds through microorganism-mediated enzymatic hydrolysis. Herein, we summarize the nutritional and functional components present in common cereal by-products, specific fermentation mechanisms for enhancing their bioactive components, and applications of fermented cereal by-products in food and other industrial sectors.

pmc-13685080.title: Inhalable epitope vaccine 1022-SpaA V3 establishes nasal mucosal fortress against zoonotic Streptococcus suis
pmc-13685080.creator: Hong Chen, Yu Zheng, Jikun Mei, Peng Zhang, Yu Li, Fengyang Li, Liancheng Lei, Na Li
pmc-13685080.description: Streptococcus suis serotype 2 (SS2), a zoonotic pathogen, can breach the respiratory barriers and cause systemic infections in both humans and swine. Current vaccines against SS2 are mainly formulated as an injectable product and primarily induce serum IgG antibodies. However, there is an urgent need for inhalable vaccines that induce the mucosal immune response.
